question: In which state from following, we can see the local wind 'Loo' in summer season from following?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Rajasthan**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Summer, which lasts from April through June in Rajasthan, is the** hottest** of all seasons.
 
• Rajasthan experiences extremely hot summers with temperatures averaging between 32 and 46 degrees Celsius.
 
• The environment is typically** 38 degrees Celsius**.
 
• **Mt Abu **is the only location in the state with a lower temperature this time of year.
 
• During the day, scorching winds from the west are known as "**Loo**" winds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Assam**:

 
 
• The northeastern Indian state of Assam is renowned for its **biodiversity**, **historical landmarks**, and **tea plantations**.
 
• The largest city in Assam, Guwahati, is located in the west and is home to the hilltop** Kamakhya Temple** and **silk bazaars**.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**:
 
 
• Maharashtra is a state in western India's peninsula that takes up a sizable chunk of the ***Deccan Plateau***.
 
• Maharashtra is the ***second-most populous*** country subdivision in the world as well as the second-most populous state in India.
 
 
 
• **Telangana**:
 
 
• A state in southern India is called **Telangana**.
 
• The **Charminar**, a 16th-century mosque in Hyderabad's capital, has four arches that support four enormous minarets.
 
• The monument offers a view of the city's venerable** Laad Bazaar**.
